correctness.rationale: Exact semigroup-product equations give disjoint source and target supports. Unique maximal cuts and diagonal clique are proved by extension/nonextension; inclusion–exclusion on full bipartite edge support yields every coefficient, and constrained cycle colorings yield both C2 character branches. The known Schur–Weyl character identity gives the Specht multiplicity. The actual packaged verifier computes literal products, independently enumerates maximal and all cliques, and exhausts S_n×C2 fixed maximal cliques through n=6. Finite tests are corroboration only; proof is general.

value.rationale: Computes the complete hierarchy of clique counts rather than merely a clique maximum. Its maximal-clique classification gives the first full inclusion-maximal family distribution for the standard graph, while the full automorphism character determines fixed facets for every conjugacy class and rational Specht multiplicities. These are canonical structural invariants, and the Euler evaluation is a meaningful consequence, not the sole contribution.
